ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Giddy-Up Pack
ModMetaData.author: Peren.
ModMetaData.description:
Giddy-Up 2 riders in IsoRim Waylith's 3D view. Riders sit on their mounts' backs, move with them, and turn to aim and shoot. Clicking, labels and first person follow the rider. With IsoRim ProjectZ: horses are parked on the rider's own floor. The 2D view stays as Giddy-Up draws it. Needs IsoRim Waylith with Api 13.
在 IsoRim Waylith 的 3D 视角里显示 Giddy-Up 2 的骑手。 骑手坐在坐骑背上，随坐骑移动，开枪时会转身瞄准。 点选、名字和第一人称都跟着骑手。 配合 IsoRim ProjectZ：坐骑停放在骑手所在的楼层。 2D 视角保持 Giddy-Up 原样。需要支持 Api 13 的 IsoRim Waylith。
